Mirror PDF — third-party notices for the web bundle and the extension
=====================================================================

This file covers the JavaScript shipped in dist/web and dist/extension.
The desktop application ships its own notices in third-party-notices/ next to
the executable (PDFium and friends).

Components bundled into the web reader / extension
--------------------------------------------------

1. pdf.js (PDF.js) — Apache License 2.0
   Copyright 2012 Mozilla Foundation and contributors.
   Used for: rendering PDF pages and reading the text layer.
   Full licence text: LICENSE-pdfjs.txt (copied verbatim from node_modules/pdfjs-dist/LICENSE).

2. lucide — ISC License
   Copyright 2022 Lucide Contributors.
   Used for: the icon set in the reader toolbar and panels.
   Full licence text: LICENSE-lucide.txt (copied verbatim from node_modules/lucide/LICENSE).

3. tesseract.js + tesseract-core — Apache License 2.0
   Used for: OCR in the browser capture and scanned-PDF paths.
   Full licence texts live beside the engine in public/ocr/LICENSE-tesseract.js.txt
   and public/ocr/LICENSE-tesseract-core.txt, and the trained models are listed in
   public/ocr/NOTICE.txt with their own licences.

4. Vite and esbuild — MIT / Apache-2.0
   Build-time only: no Vite or esbuild code is shipped in the bundles.

What is NOT a dependency of the shipped bundle
---------------------------------------------
The desktop shell (native-shell/) is Rust; its notices, including the upstream
MIT attribution for the borrowed editor engine and the PDFium licence, are
generated by scripts/package-native.ps1 into third-party-notices/.
